text:
sam: quick sync request  we keep running into tail-cost surprises from high-cardinality trace attrs. i'm thinking we should change the envelope shape to separate cheap routing attrs from expensive payload attrs so sampler/ingest can drop/strip earlier. thoughts?
izzy: yes. split header vs body. header = routing keys, billing_key, retention_hint, sample_priority. body = full span blobs + high-cardinality attrs. header must be < 1KB to stay in fast-path.
harper: agreed but we need a migration plan. many SDKs currently shove tags into top-level. propose: accept both old-style tags and new header.tags, but gateway normalizes into header and emits a migration warn metric.
dan: how will this interact with adaptive sampling? sampler needs a quick decision pre-enrich. we should run a tiny feature-set (header) through the sampler and attach sampling_reason/token to the envelope so later services know why it lived/died.
sam: exactly. sampling_reason could be a tiny enum + score. e.g., `SR_INSTRUMENTED=3, SR_HEURISTIC=5` etc. keep to 1 byte.
izzy: also add `attr_whitelist` token for tenants that want specific attrs preserved. whitelist is auth-controlled to avoid blowup.
ingest-bot: FYI: schema change will be v3.0_header_split. migration window 45d. ingest cluster will log `header_normalize_failures` counter.
harper: cost attribution: billing should consume final persisted annotation (tier/size/retention) not initial header hint. but we need provenance: add `orig_header_hash` so billing can correlate demoted/truncated events to original request when doing chargeback audits.
billing-bot: alert rule suggestion: if `header_normalize_failures > 0.1%` of ingest QPS for 5m, open ticket to SDK teams.
dan: trace reconstruction concerns: if we drop body attrs at ingest we should keep a compact summary for reconstructability: e.g., `body_digest` + `body_signals` (3-5 keywords). that keeps size down but helps search.
izzy: implementation checklist i propose: (1) header/body split on gateway, (2) sampler uses header-only fast-path, emits sample_token, (3) canonicalizer stores orig_header_hash and provenance, (4) storage records persisted_tier + body_digest and billing uses persisted tier with visibility to original hint, (5) SDK docs + migration lint.
sam: i'll write a short RFC and include example SDK change snippets. @harper can you own the billing alert thresholds?
harper: yep i'll take thresholds and add the alert to the billing runbook.
izzy: can we sync 11am tomorrow to walk through the header fields?
